title: 种群增长预测
problem_statement_md:
一个实验室里的昆虫数量每个月都会增加一倍。

以最初的昆虫数量为输入，输出一个列表，显示接下来12个月中每个月的昆虫数量，从0开始，也就是初始值。
因此，得到的列表应该包含12项，每项显示该月月初的昆虫数量。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]List Comprehensions[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

The number of insects in a lab doubles in size every month.
Take the initial number of insects as input and output a list, showing the number of insects for each of the next 12 months, starting with 0, which is the initial value.
So, the resulting list should contain 12 items, each showing the number of insects at the beginning of that month.

[b]Sample Input:[/b]
10

[b]Sample Output:[/b]
[10, 20, 40, 80, 160, 320, 640, 1280, 2560, 5120, 10240, 20480]

Create a [b]list comprehension[/b] to generate the required list.
[note]The formula to calculate the number of insects after N months will be: [b]count*2ᴺ[/b], where count is the initial number of insects.[/note]
hint_md: 计算N个月后的昆虫数量的公式: **count*2ᴺ**，其中count是昆虫的初始数量。

code_templates.solution_code:
n = int(input()) 

insects = [n*2**i for i in range(12)]

print(insects)
